title: Reprint · the Rain, 2001
logline: The papers run the 2001 Rain re-inked. Same script: the frame shop's rain alley, the dog, silent. The 2010 hand is steadier and sadder and the book runs it beside the original.

margin.note: A second, smaller date under the gull: 2001.

panels.composition: The frame shop's rain alley, 2001, as drawn in 2010: the buckets, the rain, the dog — one — at the door. The line cleaner than 2001 could manage.

image.prompt: brush-pen line with muddy early-digital flats, a narrow rain alley behind a frame shop with two upturned buckets and a small dog at a door, drawn in a clean steady brush line, no words
image.notes: A reprint: the script of dw_2001-01-12 in the 2010 hand. The book prints the 2001 original beside it.

panels.composition: WOOD, twenty, in the doorway with a mat, looking at the rain. The 2010 hand draws the twenty-year-old with more care than the twenty-year-old did.

characters.pose: in the doorway with a mat

image.prompt: brush-pen line with muddy early-digital flats, a young man in a frame-shop doorway holding a mat and looking out at rain, drawn with careful affection, no words

panels.composition: The dog going out into it. The young man not calling him back.

image.prompt: brush-pen line with muddy early-digital flats, a small dog walking out into a rainy alley while a young man in a doorway watches without calling it back, no words

panels.composition: The alley, the rain, the dog small in it, the doorway. Silent. On purpose, twice.

image.prompt: brush-pen line with muddy early-digital flats, a rain-filled alley with a small dog far down it and an empty lit doorway, no words

notes: Reprint pair, the Rain. The 2010 hand on the 2001 script.
